settings.nav.label: Settings sections
settings.general.title: General
settings.general.lead: How Klat runs on this computer.
settings.general.startAtLogin.desc: Open Klat when you start your computer.
settings.general.character.desc: Who sits in the corner. Same temper, different body.
settings.character.cat.desc: Naps hard. Wakes up already annoyed.
settings.character.snake.desc: Hisses, flicks its tongue, holds grudges.
settings.character.dragon.desc: Short fuse. Snorts smoke when it yells.
settings.character.capybara.desc: The unbothered king. Until you're needed.
settings.character.slime.desc: Jiggles, bounces, melts into a puddle.
settings.general.pause.desc: Klat keeps sleeping, whatever Claude does.
settings.general.hide.desc: It shows up only when Claude needs you.
settings.general.reduceMotion.desc: No jumps, shaking or flickering aura.
settings.general.size.desc: Drag right to make it bigger, left to make it smaller.
settings.general.move.how: Hold Space, press the mouse on Klat and drag. Release Space to drop it there.
settings.general.permission.desc: macOS asks for it so Klat can notice Space while you work in other apps.
settings.language.title: Language
settings.language.lead: What Klat shows, and what the cat says.
settings.language.klat.desc: What the cat yells. Auto mixes every language.
settings.hooks.title: Hooks
settings.hooks.lead: Klat learns that Claude Code or Codex needs you through hooks. Install them for one or both.
settings.hooks.installed.desc: {agent} tells Klat when it needs you.
settings.hooks.needsRepair.desc: Some Klat hooks are missing or point to an old copy of Klat.
settings.hooks.notInstalled.desc: The cat does not hear from {agent} until the hooks are installed.
settings.hooks.agentMissing: {agent} does not seem to be set up for you yet ({folder} not found). Installing still works; {agent} uses the hooks once it runs.
settings.hooks.codexTrust: Codex runs a new hook only after you trust it: after Install or Repair, open Codex, type /hooks and trust Klat's hooks.
settings.hooks.note: Only Klat's own entries are touched, and the old file is backed up first.
settings.advanced.title: Advanced
settings.advanced.lead: Timing, and buttons to try the cat out.
settings.advanced.yellInterval.desc: How long the cat waits before yelling again.
settings.advanced.wakeTest.desc: Wake the cat as if Claude had finished.
settings.advanced.sleep.desc: Send the cat back to sleep and dismiss what is waiting.
